arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

Justice Souter questioned the link between the plea and the sentence.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: John Stumpf pleaded guilty to aggravated murder. A lower court freed him on habeas review. The state says the plea remained valid despite the judge's error.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines when a judge's mistake invalidates a guilty plea. It sets the standard for reviewing plea agreements. It protects the finality of criminal convictions.
